text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан claims her second crown at
the
Japanese Derby. While the entire
racing world is
abuzz, Бива Хаяхидэ
speaks at a press
conference for the
upcoming Takarazuka Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There, she declares that not only will she
win the
Takarazuka Kinen, she will
eventually compete
against her sister.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There's more attention on her than ever
before.
Meanwhile, I gather data on her
competition to
give her the best chance
of success.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I watch footage of the Derby for
research and am
shocked by the
unbelievable speed Нарита Брайан
can put
forth. It's no wonder they call her the

Beast.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
